scope: Frozen neural/count patcher comparison; no cache reuse or refitting
limitations: Protected exact/URL/MinHash128 approximate dedup reused, not exhaustive or unseen model-pretraining proof. Frozen F1-selected rule; F0.5 reporting is not retuning. Warm LMDB and original patcher weights stay resident. No full candidate adoption follows from a single criterion.

protocol.quality: Entire test and wikipedia_test; nonoverlapping 2047-byte chunks with BOS per chunk; no appended special target; all original bytes scored; reset count state per chunk
protocol.boundary_positions: 2..input_length inclusive; starts 0/1 excluded, virtual next-byte position included, same label contract

timing.measurement: Full-model last-logit teacher-forced same-byte replay; not free generation
timing.order: original/count on even repeat indices, reversed on odd indices; warmups included
timing.inputs: Exact eight split/length/document/ID cases from timing reference
timing.priming: One full-model forward on prefix ending 32 IDs before endpoint, excluded from timing
timing.timed_work: 32 full-model forwards on identical growing prefixes, ending at recorded input length
timing.excluded: Model loading, priming, sampling, byte selection, output decoding and correctness controls
timing.included: Count lookup, CPU work, transfers, patcher, encoder, global transformer and decoder
timing.controls: Every count replay step must exactly match fresh-prefix patch lengths and logits
timing.time_unit: seconds for the entire 32-forward block; not single-step percentiles
